Class weighting.how: each flow weighted by the inverse frequency of its class; no rows added

SMOTE (SMOTENC).how: synthetic minority flows interpolated between each rare flow and its 5 nearest same-class neighbours; categorical features take the neighbours' most common value rather than being interpolated (SMOTENC)

Borderline-SMOTE.how: as SMOTE, but only near the decision boundary where confusion actually happens; classes with no borderline examples are left untouched

Random undersampling.how: majority classes randomly cut down to the size of the smallest class
